description: Database migration and content helpers - Create the page_content table migration (already exists at supabase/migrations/create_page_content_cms.sql), verify its structure matches requirements, and build typed helper functions in lib/supabase/content-helpers.ts to fetch and update page content with proper TypeScript interfaces for each page type
steps: Read and verify supabase/migrations/create_page_content_cms.sql matches the required schema (table with page_slug, section_key, content_value columns, RLS policies for public read and authenticated write)

If the migration structure is outdated or uses a different schema than required (e.g., old format with page_slug + content JSONB vs. new format with page_slug + section_key + content_value), replace it with the correct schema that stores each content field as a separate row

Create lib/supabase/content-helpers.ts with TypeScript interfaces: HomeContent (hero_title, hero_subtitle, hero_cta_primary, hero_cta_secondary, about_title, about_description, cta_title, cta_description, cta_button), AboutContent, ServicesContent, ContactContent, ProjectsContent, TeamContent, CareersContent
Implement getPageContent(pageSlug: string) function that fetches all rows for a page_slug, converts them to a key-value object, returns with fallback to hardcoded defaults from existing code

Implement typed wrappers: getHomeContent(), getAboutContent(), getServicesContent(), getContactContent(), getProjectsContent(), getTeamContent(), getCareersContent() that call getPageContent() and cast to the appropriate interface
Add getAllPagesMetadata() function that returns list of all 7 pages with slug, last updated timestamp, number of content fields
acceptance_criteria: supabase/migrations/create_page_content_cms.sql exists and contains the correct schema with page_slug, section_key, content_value columns
lib/supabase/content-helpers.ts exports TypeScript interfaces for all 7 page types
All helper functions (getPageContent, getHomeContent, etc.) are implemented and return properly typed data
Functions gracefully handle missing data by returning sensible defaults matching the existing hardcoded values in the codebase
verification: Read lib/supabase/content-helpers.ts and confirm all functions and interfaces are present
Check that TypeScript compilation succeeds: run `pnpm build` and verify no type errors related to the new helper functions
Visually inspect that default values in getPageContent match the existing hardcoded content from components/home/*.tsx and app/page.tsx
findings: Migration file verified with correct schema (page_slug, section_key, content_value). All 7 TypeScript interfaces created (HomeContent, AboutContent, ServicesContent, ContactContent, ProjectsContent, TeamContent, CareersContent). Implemented getPageContent() and 7 typed wrapper functions with proper fallback defaults. Added getAllPagesMetadata() for CMS listing. Note: PowerShell execution policy prevented build command from running, but TypeScript file structure and syntax manually verified against project patterns.
